title: ACM Problem Solving Platform
description: A website designed to help users solve ACM programming problems efficiently.

features.name: Problem Repository
features.description: A comprehensive collection of ACM problems categorized by difficulty and topic.

features.name: Solution Submission
features.description: Allows users to submit their solutions and receive instant feedback on correctness and efficiency.

features.name: User Profiles
features.description: Enables users to create profiles to track their progress and achievements.

features.name: Leaderboard
features.description: Displays rankings based on user performance and problem-solving speed.

features.name: Discussion Forum
features.description: A space for users to discuss problems, share insights, and collaborate.

target_users: Students and competitive programmers interested in ACM challenges
data_requirements: Requires storage for user profiles, problem data, and solution submissions
